description: This file defines the `AppSetupUtility` class, which provides utility methods for setting up, migrating, and managing the database during the installation process of the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for database creation, connection, configuration insertion, migration execution, and cleanup.

classes.name: AppSetupUtility
classes.description: Provides methods for database setup, configuration, migration, and cleanup during the HRM software installation process.

methods.name: createNewDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database schema with the specified name.

methods.name: connectToDatabaseServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database server without selecting a specific database.

methods.name: isDatabaseExist
methods.description: Checks if a database with the specified name exists on the server.

methods.name: isDatabaseUserExist
methods.description: Checks if a specific database user exists.

methods.name: connectToDatabase
methods.description: Connects to an existing database.

methods.name: isExistingDatabaseEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the existing database is empty.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database or verifies conditions for existing ones based on installation type.

methods.name: insertSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Inserts initial system configuration values into the database.

methods.name: insertCsrfKey
methods.description: Generates and inserts a CSRF secret key into configuration.

methods.name: insertOrganizationInfo
methods.description: Inserts organization information into the database.

methods.name: insertSubunitOrganizationName
methods.description: Updates subunit table with organization name.

methods.name: setDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets default language configuration.

methods.name: insertAdminEmployee
methods.description: Inserts a default admin employee record.

methods.name: insertAdminUser
methods.description: Creates a default admin user account with hashed password.

methods.name: updateUniqueIdForAdminEmployeeInsertion
methods.description: Updates the unique ID counter for admin employee records.

methods.name: insertInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Inserts or generates a unique instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates an instance identifier from data and system configuration.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Collects data to generate an instance identifier.

methods.name: createDBUser
methods.description: Creates database user accounts for the application if needed.

methods.name: getUserCreationQueries
methods.description: Generates SQL queries for creating and granting permissions to a database user.

methods.name: writeConfFile
methods.description: Writes database connection info into configuration files from a template.

methods.name: writeKeyFile
methods.description: Creates a cryptographic key file.

methods.name: getVersionsInRange
methods.description: Returns a list of migration versions within a specified range.

methods.name: runMigrations
methods.description: Runs database migrations between specified versions.

methods.name: runMigrationFor
methods.description: Runs migration scripts for a specific version.

methods.name: throwMigrationErrorIfPreviousIncomplete
methods.description: Throws error if previous migration was incomplete.

methods.name: _runMigration
methods.description: Executes a specific migration class.

methods.name: disableExecutionTimeLimit
methods.description: Disables time limits for script execution during migrations.

methods.name: getCurrentProductVersionFromDatabase
methods.description: Retrieves current product version from the database based on migration history.

methods.name: cleanUpInstallOnFailure
methods.description: Drops all tables and resets database if installation fails.

methods.name: dropDatabase
methods.description: Drops the specified database.
